Game updates
Season 122
## New cards
* [card image] Kawkaw. COST 1. ATK 1. HP 2. Magic: Give an ally monster +1/+2 and Paralyze it.
* [card image] Raincoat Spider. COST 2. ATK 1. HP 3. After you play an Arachnid not Generated by Raincoat Spider, add a Spider to your hand.
* [card image] Wind Struggler. COST 3. ATK 2. HP 4. All other monsters take +1 DMG.
* [card image] Spikery. COST 4. ATK 3. HP 4. Taunt. Need: You spent G on a spell and a monster last turn. Magic: Add 3 Shields to your hand.
* [card image] Ice-E Banner. COST 6. ATK 4. HP 4. Magic: Silence a monster. Then Paralyze it, give it KR, and make it Wanted.
* [card image] Lost Noelle. COST 8. ATK 8. HP 8. Quest: The Forbidden Path. Magic: Kill all other ally monsters. Add a 2-cost Ice Crystal to your hand for each.
* [card image] Vampire Alvin. COST 8. ATK 5. HP 5. Taunt. Magic: Give a non-DT monster -3/-3/-3 (min. 1 HP). Delay: If it's alive, add an exact copy of it to your hand.
